summary: The file transcribes Artin's classical presentation of B_n and the standard Birman-chapter-1 derived structure but carries no `## References` section, breaking the repo convention that every KnotTheory and presented-group file names the source of its presentation. No vendoring or close following of an unnamed formalization, so this is fixable rather than blocking.
